description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Notify the Collective Agreement entered into between Trinco Holiday Resorts (Pvt.) Limited and Food Beverages & Tobacco Industries Employees Union (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a private company and a trade union in accordance with Section 06 of the Industrial Disputes Act. It establishes legal terms and conditions of employment, including salary structures, working hours, overtime provisions, and dispute resolution mechanisms. This constitutes a regulatory framework under existing labor legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a commercial matter.
